description: Source code for an Android activity controlling a USB missile launcher via accelerometer and button input.

classes.name: MissileLauncherActivity
classes.description: Main activity for controlling a USB missile launcher with accelerometer input and a fire button.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, button listener, and USB and sensor managers.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listener and handles USB device attachment/detachment.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle method, currently no additional cleanup.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Sets up USB device interface and endpoint, starts communication thread.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends control command to USB device.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles fire button click to send fire command.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Thread method to poll USB device status and handle firing logic.
